pages.name: English: Four Knights, 4.g3 d5 5.cxd5 Nxd5 6.Bg2 Nb6 7.O-O Be7 8.Rb1
pages.notes: Plan 2 read b4 as a Black move; plan 4 was a vague 'both sides manoeuvre' line. Rewrote plans 2 and 4; British spelling.

pages.name: English Opening: Symmetrical Variation, Hedgehog Defense
pages.notes: Plan 1 called d4 a Maroczy Bind; plan 3 pushed f4 through the f3-knight; plan 4 rerouted a knight via d7-b8-c6. Rewrote plans 1, 3 and 4; British spelling.

pages.name: English: Symmetrical, 2.Nf3 Nf6 3.g3
pages.notes: Plan 1 wrote castling as 0-0; plan 4 described a Maroczy Bind after cxd5 and e4, which cannot arise once White's c-pawn has gone. Rewrote plans 2 and 4; British spelling.

pages.name: English: Symmetrical, Double Fianchetto
pages.notes: Overview did not name the real plans; plan 2 read d4 as a Black move. Rewrote overview and plan 2 around d4, ...cxd4 Nxd4 and the swap of light-squared bishops. Reviewer rejections (White has not double-fianchettoed; the f6-knight blocks the g7-bishop) fixed and re-reviewed.

pages.name: English: Symmetrical, Hedgehog, 6...a6
pages.notes: Plan 3 read d5 and f5 as moves; plan 4 rerouted a knight from e8 to f6 or g7. Rewrote plans 3-4; British spelling.

pages.name: English: Symmetrical, Hedgehog, 7.b3
pages.notes: Plan 3 proposed a4-a5 against b6; plan 4 named ...Rce8. Rewrote plans 3-4 around Bb2 and the full Hedgehog set-up. Reviewer rejection (e3 does not open the centre) fixed and re-reviewed.

pages.name: English: Symmetrical, Hedgehog, 7.b3
pages.notes: Plan 3 played Qe2 through the e2-pawn; plan 4 rerouted a knight from d7, where none stands, via e8 to c7. Rewrote plans 3-4; British spelling.

pages.name: English: Symmetrical, Hedgehog, 8.Qxd4
pages.notes: Plan 1 prepared e4 with f3 (the knight is there); plan 3 moved the queen to c3, where White's knight stands; plan 4 suggested ...Rd8 with the queen on d8. Rewrote plans 1, 3 and 4; British spelling.

pages.name: English: Symmetrical, Hedgehog, 8.Qxd4 O-O
pages.notes: Plan 4 named ...Rce8. Rewrote plan 4; British spelling.

pages.name: English: Symmetrical, Hedgehog, 9.b3 Nbd7 10.Nb5
pages.notes: Plan 1 put the c1-bishop on both a3 and b2; both plans called for ...b5 with White's knight on b5. Rewrote both plans; plan 2 now names the real threat to d6.
